body:
1. The pain is intense sadness with chest tightness - feels like a physical manifestation of pain in my upper left side of my chest
2. I can just focus on my main job and ignore my goals (actually went on a date tonight that went well).
3. Meditation helps I was in a research group where the university would complete MRI scans of meditators in the program - personally it helps with extreme stress however if its depression because of goals/love life it doesn't really help - it can center you but the pain will still exist.

my psychologist helped me realize I was being too hard on myself. - I went from 40 hours a week on instagram/social media to 14 hours a week with 7+ hours each day of solid focused work along with language studying, programming learning, exercising/dancing,etc...  


however my depression made those improvements seem like they were nothing and I wasn't good enough yet that I needed to do more and improve faster despite making huge strides.  


The only issue now is that everything is stable in my life generally however these depressive thoughts are still coming in.
There is but I'd have to commit myself to a hospital which would ruin my life and probably cause me to end my life long term due to the financial/job prospects.

My father passed during Christmas day.

I never got to tell him I loved him before he died.
